_nota: Opening y ending de la serie. Se generan UNA VEZ y se reutilizan en los doce episodios: no se vuelven a generar nunca, se pegan como capa. herramientas/parche-datos.mjs los mete en datos/serie.json. Los prompts de imagen y vídeo van en inglés porque son para los modelos; todo lo demás, en español.
_decision_pendiente: OJO, son DOS cosas distintas y no se mezclan. (1) El opening y el ending son las canciones DE LA SERIE: llevan letra cantada EN JAPONÉS y subtítulo en español, como cualquier animé. Están escritas abajo, en 'letra'. (2) La canción de la MADRE es otra cosa: es un elemento de la historia, va en un idioma que no se habla en ese mundo, y esa decisión sigue siendo del episodio 10 (serie.json, musica.letra_mas_adelante). No se unifican: la de la madre no es el opening.

musica.pista: canción con letra cantada en japonés
musica.encargo:
Opening theme for a bleak adult anime drama, ninety seconds, building to a full chorus. A female lead vocal, low and worn rather than bright, singing over a sparse dark orchestral arrangement. Opens with a solo wooden flute playing a broken folk melody. Low strings enter underneath at fifteen seconds. The vocal enters at eighteen seconds. A dry hand-drum pulse with no reverb begins at thirty seconds and grows. The chorus arrives at fifty-five seconds, full ensemble, the vocal exhausted rather than triumphant. Ends unresolved. The song is sung in JAPANESE, with these exact lyrics and no others:
灰の中で 目を開けた
誰も名を 呼ばなかった
濡れた石の 冷たさだけ
覚えている
見つからないで と あなたは言った
ここは 輝くものを壊すから
だから僕は 光を消した
誰にも 見えないように
いつか この目が
世界を 黙らせる
二度と 奪わせない
Clear diction, the words must be intelligible. No English anywhere in the vocal. No brass fanfare, no electronic drums, no synth pads, no major-key triumph, no pop production.
musica.negativo: english lyrics, spanish lyrics, korean lyrics, mumbled or unintelligible vocals, brass fanfare, electronic drums, synth pads, uplifting major-key resolution, pop production, electric guitar, rap
musica.nota: Canción de la serie, con letra en japonés y subtítulo en español, como cualquier animé. No confundir con la canción de la madre, que es otra cosa y va en otro idioma.

musica.pista: canción con letra cantada en japonés
musica.encargo:
Ending theme for a bleak adult anime drama, ninety seconds, almost still. A solo female voice, low breathy mezzo, exhausted and intimate, as if singing to a child in a dark room. Recorded close and dry. A single sustained low string underneath that never moves. The voice enters at twelve seconds. A wooden flute answers once near the end and does not finish its phrase. Fades to nothing. The song is sung in JAPANESE, with these exact lyrics and no others:
眠りなさい 小さな手
血の匂いは すぐ消える
わたしの声を 忘れても
この歌だけ 残るでしょう
神になる前の あなたを
見た者を 忘れないで
花は枯れても
ここに あるから
Clear diction, the words must be intelligible. No English anywhere in the vocal. No percussion of any kind, no choir, no harmony, no build, no climax, no resolution.
musica.negativo: english lyrics, spanish lyrics, mumbled or unintelligible vocals, percussion, drums, choir, backing vocals, harmony, build, climax, brass, electronic elements, pop production
musica.nota: Es la melodía de la madre con letra. Lo que canta aquí es literalmente lo que ella le dijo en el teaser: «no olvides quién te vio antes de que fueras dios». Por eso el ending cierra cada episodio y no el opening.

tomas.imagen: Extreme low angle of a vaulted stone crypt ceiling, ribbed arches lost in darkness, thick torch smoke drifting across, no figures
tomas.video: The smoke drifts and the torchlight breathes. Camera cranes slowly upward. Nothing else moves.

tomas.imagen: Close shot of a gaunt young woman lying on a dark stone altar, head turned to one side, eyes open and empty, orange torchlight raking across her face
tomas.video: Her eyes stay open. One slow blink and nothing else. Camera locked.

tomas.imagen: Extreme close up of the mother's open hand falling slack across the dark stone altar, fingers uncurling, wet firelight raking over the polished stone, and beside her hand two small points of red light reflected in the stone, no figures
tomas.video: The hand settles and stops. The two red reflections hold steady and do not flicker with the fire. Very slow push in.

tomas.imagen: Low angle of a figure in a dark robe wearing a leather mask moulded into a demonic grin, torchlight from below, hooded figures behind out of focus
tomas.video: The mask turns slowly toward camera and stops. Everything else is still.

tomas.imagen: A small boy of five standing alone in a mud alley in the rain, an oversized worn tunic with long sleeves, patched and travel-stained, simple cloth shoes, quiet serious face, leaning shacks around him
tomas.video: Rain falls. He does not move and does not flinch. Camera pushes in very slowly.

tomas.imagen: A ten year old boy seen from behind running through a flooded stone tunnel, shallow water, cold light far ahead
tomas.video: He runs away from camera through the water, splashing. Camera tracks behind him. Face never visible.

tomas.imagen: A ten year old boy alone at a low desk in a bare stone hall, rows of empty desks around him, torchlight, a blackened writing wall behind
tomas.video: He writes. Only the hand moves. Camera locked, very slow push in.

tomas.imagen: A boy of twelve standing still on wet cobbles between shuttered shopfronts, spaced lamps, people passing him as blurs
tomas.video: The crowd moves past him; he stays perfectly still and watches. Camera locked.

tomas.imagen: A young man of seventeen in an immaculate dark charcoal noble coat standing at a heavy desk, warm gold lamplight, ledgers and sealing wax, no expression
tomas.video: He lifts his head from the ledger and looks off-frame. Nothing else moves. Camera locked.

tomas.imagen: A dry stone room under a city, one lantern, and a whole wall covered floor to ceiling in pinned papers, maps, lists and cord
tomas.video: The lantern flame wavers and the papers stir. Slow lateral pan across the wall.

tomas.imagen: High wide shot of an empty council chamber, a shallow amphitheatre of dark benches around a speaker's floor, gold light and dust from high windows
tomas.video: Dust drifts in the light shafts. Very slow push in toward the empty floor. Nobody is there.

tomas.imagen: A young woman of twenty with dark blonde hair pinned up, wide brown eyes, alert and unafraid, standing among tall windows and faded tapestries
tomas.video: She turns her head toward camera and almost smiles. Camera locked.

tomas.imagen: A young woman with long silver hair and dark green eyes standing among enormous ancient tree trunks, shafts of daylight, plain undyed linen
tomas.video: The light shifts through the canopy across her face. She does not move. Camera locked.

tomas.imagen: A man of twenty-five leaning on a crutch, a burn scar across one cheek, standing among hundreds of cloth and mud tents and small fires
tomas.video: Smoke drifts across the frame. He shifts his weight on the crutch once. Camera locked.

tomas.imagen: A young man of eighteen, handsome and certain, black hair oiled back, sharp silver and grey clothing, standing in a cold marble hall
tomas.video: He turns toward camera with the ease of someone who has never been refused. Camera locked.

tomas.imagen: A lean immaculate man of fifty with iron-grey hair and a cold courteous face, silver and grey, in a hall of marble and silver with no dust
tomas.video: He looks directly at camera without moving anything else. Camera locked.

tomas.imagen: A heavy man of twenty-five going soft, dark curly hair, flushed face, good clothes badly worn, standing in a mud alley in the rain
tomas.video: Rain runs off him. He looks over his shoulder, one step behind. Camera locked.

tomas.imagen: A woman with a cadaverous face and shaven head, bone pendants, dark cult robe, lit only by torchlight from below, devout and gentle

tomas.imagen: An ordinary old man in his seventies with a mild pleasant face and close-cropped white hair, plain dark robe, torchlight from below, no mask

tomas.imagen: Medium shot from behind of a young man in an immaculate dark noble coat standing motionless in a great hall while guests move around him

ending.nota_letra: Los tiempos son PLANEADOS, no medidos. Lyria no canta al segundo lo que se le pide, así que la pantalla de Audio deja escuchar la pista y marcar cada línea con el dedo. Hasta que una línea no está marcada (confirmada:true en el estado), no se quema como subtítulo: un subtítulo que no cuadra con lo que suena es peor que no ponerlo.

_letra_aprobada: Las dos letras están APROBADAS y no se tocan sin decirlo. El opening lo canta él y recoge las dos frases de la madre del teaser; el ending lo canta ELLA y su centro es su frase palabra por palabra. Por eso cada episodio abre con lo que él decidió ser y cierra con la que lo vio antes. Si algún día hay que cambiar un verso, se cambia aquí, se vuelve a generar la pieza y se vuelven a marcar los tiempos: los de la versión anterior ya no valen.
